name: 樊稠

exactCharacter.y: 樊稠，凉州金城人是东汉末年的军阀、将领。官至右将军，因为在联合李傕[jué]郭汜等人，围攻长安，迎接汉献帝，被封为万年侯。 原为董卓部将，董卓死后，伙同李傕、郭汜、张济等人合众十余万反扑长安，败吕布、杀王允，把持朝政。后马腾因与李傕有隙，于是联合韩遂举兵进攻，李傕派樊稠、郭汜等与其交战，大败马腾、韩遂于长平观下。樊稠追至陈仓，与韩遂友好罢兵，却遭李傕猜疑。兴平二年（195年），李傕让外甥骑都尉胡封在会议上将樊稠刺死。
exactCharacter.z: 点数为6的牌多为【乐不思蜀】或基本牌，可以用来限制敌人的行动。
exactCharacter.x: 乱世中，####也有我的一杯羹。

exactSpells.o:
出牌阶段限一次，当你使用牌后，你可以选择一项：
 1.获得场上一张点数为6的牌；
 2.从牌堆中两张点数为6的牌中选择一张获得（没有则摸一张牌）；
 3.令一名其他角色弃置一张点数为6的牌或交给你一张牌。
exactSpells.v: 请选择一项;请选择一个目标
exactSpells.w: 请选择一张牌交给{0};请弃置一张点数为6的牌

implementationInterpretations: Only actual completed Use actions during the owner actual Play can offer the once-phase skill. Native own Dodge/Nullification completed-use windows are considered through existing use classification; ordinary response-only Slash or ArrowBarrage Dodge are excluded.
Field means real Equipment/Judgment physical entities, not private hands, processing or private/public character piles. All payment/obtain protection uses native movement legality.

For the deck choice, freeze up to the first two matching rank-six entities in native top-to-bottom draw-pile order (native top is the last stored entity); the text does not say random. One matching entity remains a valid sole option; no matching entity falls back to a real draw-one. This is a implementation interpretation, not an official FAQ.

Recipient independently chooses a legal autonomous HE discard of a rank-six entity or a legal HE transfer. A restricted autonomous discard cannot be forced through the gift branch or substituted by the source owner.
New entity IDs and deck faces belong only to trusted owning frame receipts and authorized private viewer projections, never public payment facts.
Only living field owners and living other recipients are considered. Equipment/general-weapon protections and autonomous discard restrictions use existing native legality.
Unpaid source loss cancels; after an actual issued movement/draw, its exact owned child subtree drains once despite source loss or owner death. No additional unpaid gain is generated after death.
